description: Illustrative retention scenarios for a $29 monthly subscription after the first settled payment. These are not Formflow measurements or industry benchmarks. Replace them with observed paid-cohort revenue and retention before treating subscription ROAS as factual.

operating_anchor.interpretation: Contribution payback month is the first month cumulative expected subscription gross profit covers acquisition spend. Grades are an internal operating scale, not an industry benchmark.
